title: Fix Sketchpad XState Context In ModelPiece
description: Fix XState actor context for GoldenLayout windows
summary: Fixed the sketchpad Design scene crash caused by ModelPiece referencing an undefined actor. Routed piece selection updates through the existing design-app selection hook, added an explicit regression assertion for the missing-actor runtime error in the embedded Design Playwright test, and verified the design route at runtime against the metabolism fixture with no console or page errors.
